angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 549,603 km at 174.64 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.7262 +/- 0.0134 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 174.64 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.79 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Hebrard et al. 2013, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-52 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...549A.134H/abstract): 549,603 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.87 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Hebrard et al. 2013, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-52 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...549A.134H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5000 +/- 100 K from Hebrard et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-52 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...549A.134H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hebrard et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-52 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...549A.134H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-52.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.582, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-52 (pscomppars): spectral type K2 V, from Hebrard et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...549A.134H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-52 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Hebrard et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...549A.134H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-52 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.35366, from Chen et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...600L..11C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-52 (pscomppars): age 0.4 Gyr, from Hebrard et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...549A.134H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-52 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.6 km/s, from Hebrard et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...549A.134H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
